title: Crisp Corn Tostadas with Chicken, Refried Beans and Avocado
summary: Crisp baked corn tostada shells are layered with smooth refried beans, lime-tossed shredded chicken and fresh avocado for a quick, colourful plate. Shredded lettuce and crumbled queso fresco add crunch and a salty finish.
equipment: large frying pan (30 cm), preferably non-stick

ingredients.item: canned pinto beans (2 cans), drained and rinsed
fine sea salt or table salt
boneless, skinless chicken breasts, sliced 1 cm thick
fine sea salt or table salt
queso fresco or feta, crumbled (check the rennet)

steps.title: Bake the tostada shells
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brush the tortillas lightly with the 2 tablespoons oil on both sides and lay them in a single layer across the two trays. Bake for 8-12 minutes, turning once and swapping the trays halfway through, until golden and crisp right out to the edges; they firm up further as they cool on the rack. Turning and swapping trays evens out the oven's hot spots so every shell crisps at roughly the same rate.

steps.title: Cook the refried beans
steps.text: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in the frying pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes, stirring, until soft and turning golden. Stir in the garlic and cumin for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the beans, water and the 1/4 teaspoon salt and simmer for 5 minutes. Mash with a potato masher until thick and creamy, like soft hummus, then scrape into a bowl, cover and wipe out the pan; the mash thickens slightly as it cools, so don't worry if it looks a touch loose at first.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Toss the sliced chicken with the cumin, 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in the pan over medium-high heat until shimmering, then cook the chicken for 5-7 minutes, stirring now and then, until browned and the thickest piece reaches 74°C on a thermometer. Take the pan off the heat, pull the chicken into rough shreds with two forks and toss through the lime juice, which adds a bright lift against the richness of the beans and cheese.

steps.title: Build and serve
steps.text: Spread each crisp shell with a layer of the warm beans, then pile on the chicken, lettuce, queso fresco, avocado and coriander. Serve the tostadas straight away with lime wedges on the side, since the shells soften quickly once the warm toppings go on and are best eaten without delay.

tips: Let the shells cool fully on a rack before stacking them - stacking warm shells traps steam and makes them go soft instead of staying crisp.
Check the chicken's thickest piece with a thermometer rather than relying on colour alone; thin slices finish nearer 5 minutes, thicker ones closer to 7.
Build the tostadas just before serving - assembled too far ahead, the beans soften the crisp base from underneath.
Mash the beans while they're still warm, as cooled beans are harder to work into a smooth paste.
Slice the avocado at the last minute so it doesn't brown before serving.
storage: Refrigerate the cooked chicken and beans separately within 1 hour and use within 3 days, reheating once until piping hot (74°C). Keep the shells airtight at room temperature for up to 2 days, stored separately from the toppings, and assemble just before eating. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
